story: Pippin Paddlepaw and the Seven Golden Acorns

scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. scenes.title: Rosie Red-Hen's Flour Mill
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Outside a cozy thatched cottage mill with flower boxes, Rosie Red-Hen (russet speckled hen in white linen apron from ref_characters.jpg) sifts golden oat flour into a ceramic bowl while Pippin Paddlepaw rolls up his sky-blue waistcoat sleeves to help.

scenes.title: Stirring the Sweet Berry Batter
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Inside Rosie Red-Hen's warm sunlit cottage kitchen, Pippin Paddlepaw and Rosie Red-Hen stir sweet wild-blueberries and golden honey into muffin batter using a carved wooden spoon, while Bramble Red-Squirrel peers cheerfully through the open Dutch window.

scenes.title: The First Golden Acorn Shines
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Rosie Red-Hen presents a tray of steaming golden honey-oat muffins on a checkered garden table and hands Pippin Paddlepaw the first glowing Golden Acorn token, which shines with warm amber light.

scenes.title: Clara Rook and the Tall Stone Pitcher
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. By a mossy stone garden courtyard, Clara Rook (glossy indigo bird in brass spectacles and yellow scarf from ref_characters.jpg) peers into a tall narrow terracotta garden pitcher where fresh spring water sparkles near the bottom, while Pippin Paddlepaw kneels beside her.

scenes.title: Pebble by Pebble, Up Comes the Water
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Close-up storybook scene: Pippin Paddlepaw holds two smooth round river pebbles in his paws while Clara Rook drops a smooth grey pebble from her beak into the mouth of the tall terracotta pitcher, tiny water ripples rising inside.

scenes.title: The Star-Lilies Bloom Again
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Sparkling clear water brims at the very top rim of the terracotta pitcher, watering a pot of golden star-lilies beside it. Clara Rook and Pippin Paddlepaw clap their wings and paws in celebration.

scenes.title: The Second Golden Acorn
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Clara Rook perches on the rim of the watered star-lily pot and places the second glowing Golden Acorn into Pippin Paddlepaw's woven willow satchel.

scenes.title: Barnaby Badger and the Tangled Wheelbarrow
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. On a mossy woodland lane, Barnaby Badger (friendly striped badger in green corduroy overalls from ref_characters.jpg) stands beside his wooden wheelbarrow loaded with pumpkins, its wheel gently tangled in curly green morning-glory vines.

scenes.title: Little Paws Do What Big Paws Cannot
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Tiny Penny Harvest-Mouse (in gingham pinafore) and Pippin Paddlepaw carefully untie the soft green morning-glory vine knots from the spokes of Barnaby Badger's wooden wheelbarrow wheel while Barnaby smiles gratefully.

scenes.title: Big Paws Return the Favor at the Brook
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. At the pebble brook crossing from ref_key_setting.jpg, a fallen mossy birch branch rests across the footpath. Strong Barnaby Badger effortlessly lifts the mossy branch aside with both paws so Pippin Paddlepaw and Penny Harvest-Mouse can walk across.

scenes.title: The Third Golden Acorn
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Barnaby Badger tips his felt gardener's hat and hands Pippin Paddlepaw the third glowing Golden Acorn beside the clear pebble brook.

scenes.title: Bramble Squirrel's Silly Acorn Alarm
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. High on a sunny oak branch above the meadow, Bramble Red-Squirrel (in berry-red vest from ref_characters.jpg) rings his tiny brass bell and giggles playfully while Pippin Paddlepaw and Barnaby Badger run up carrying an empty acorn basket.

scenes.title: When the Basket Really Tips Over
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Beneath the oak tree, Bramble Red-Squirrel's wicker basket tips over on a mossy root, spilling dozens of shiny brown acorns rolling down into the tall clover while Bramble rings his bell with an apologetic, hopeful expression.

scenes.title: Pippin Checks and Bramble Promises
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Pippin Paddlepaw kneels in the green clover beside Bramble Red-Squirrel, helping him gather the scattered acorns back into the wicker basket while Bramble holds his paw over his heart in an honest promise.

scenes.title: The Fourth Golden Acorn
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Bramble Red-Squirrel beams proudly and presents Pippin Paddlepaw with the fourth glowing Golden Acorn from the very center of the neatly refilled wicker basket.

scenes.title: Hopper Cricket's Merry Autumn Tune
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. In a golden autumn meadow with swirling orange maple leaves, Hopper Cricket (in leaf-green tailcoat playing a tiny wooden fiddle) dances on a mushroom cap while Penny Harvest-Mouse and Pippin Paddlepaw stack dry pine-cones and sweet chestnuts into a cozy hollow-log pantry.

scenes.title: The Cool Evening Breeze Arrives
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Crisp twilight blue settles over the meadow as a gentle autumn breeze flutters the leaves. Hopper Cricket wraps his arms around his shoulders feeling chilly, while warm golden lantern light glows from the door of Penny Harvest-Mouse's hollow-log cottage.

scenes.title: Warm Cider, Preparation, and Sharing
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Inside the cozy hollow-log cottage, Pippin Paddlepaw wraps a soft wool blanket around Hopper Cricket's shoulders and hands him a mug of warm spiced apple cider, while Hopper Cricket tunes his fiddle to play for his friends.

scenes.title: The Fifth Golden Acorn
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Penny Harvest-Mouse and Hopper Cricket together place the fifth glowing Golden Acorn into Pippin Paddlepaw's paws beside the warm cottage hearth.

scenes.title: Tilly Terrapin, Dash Jackrabbit, and the Hilltop Trail
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. At the base of the winding lantern trail leading up to the Grand Willow Tree from ref_key_setting.jpg, Dash Jackrabbit (in striped athletic sash) bounds ahead up the hill while Tilly Terrapin (in lavender shawl) and Pippin Paddlepaw walk steadily step by step carrying a brass lantern.

scenes.title: Slow and Steady Passes the Snoozing Hare
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. Halfway up the mossy hillside path, Dash Jackrabbit snoozes peacefully curled up on a soft patch of sunlit clover, while Tilly Terrapin and Pippin Paddlepaw walk calmly past him with steady smiles.

scenes.title: The Breeze and the Golden Sunbeam
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths. In the sky above the Grand Willow Tree, a playful puff of silver breeze blows gently, and then a warm golden sunbeam shines down through the willow boughs, illuminating Tilly Terrapin and Pippin Paddlepaw as they place the sixth and seventh Golden Acorns into the tree's lantern hooks.

scenes.title: The Grand Willow Lantern Festival Under the Stars
scenes.prompt: Maintain strict visual continuity with ImagePaths.
